01 — About

Who I
Am

I'm Mohammad Kaif Raj, a Computer Science & Engineering student at United International University in Dhaka. My work connects web development, practical hardware experiments, and entrepreneurship — with a focus on making useful ideas tangible.

Recent work includes Krishi, a PHP/MySQL farming platform, AgriNest, an Arduino irrigation prototype, and this interactive portfolio. Outside code, I bring a founder’s perspective through Flawed Urbanwear and experience in tutoring and campus communities. I currently serve as Co-Head of the Public Relations and Communications Department at English Language Forum (ELF).

04 — Brand

My
Venture

Started Flawed Urbanwear right after 12th grade. Used my father's garment industry knowledge to source quality surplus materials. Focused on unisex styles and inclusive sizing so everyone finds their perfect fit.

What began as a small idea is now a growing streetwear brand built on sustainability and belonging.
